tool_signatures.name: spam_detector
tool_signatures.description: Heuristically identify likely-spam calls and (optionally) tag them.

days.description: Lookback window (1-90; 90 is hard-capped to avoid memory blowup on high-volume clients: full call list is materialized for scoring before truncating the response).

auto_tag.description: If True, ADD `tag_name` to each likely-spam call after the scan. Default False (preview only). Note: we deliberately do NOT mark calls as spam=True automatically: CallRail HIDES spam-flagged calls from default GET endpoints, so self-reviewing them later becomes painful. Tag first, manually spam-flag if confirmed.

tag_name.description: The tag to add when auto_tag=True. Default 'auto_detected_spam'. Auto-creates the tag at company level if it doesn't exist (CallRail's behavior).
